set.body: Extend the StatFrame/ComputedAesthetic pipeline established by e16f467 with scientific staples: Stat.Bin for histograms, grouped summary (mean plus typed interval output), and density. Each stat must feed plot-wide scale training, reject incoherent geom/aesthetic combinations as GraphicsError, and carry R/ggplot2 parity fixtures on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Graphics: typed bin, summary, and density statistics
